# 0005 — Celsius to Fahrenheit

**Language:** C

**Difficulty:** 🟢 easy

**Tested skills:**
- arithmetic operators

## Task

Complete **`ex_0005_CelsiusToFahrenheit`** so that it converts the
temperature **`temperatureC`** (degrees Celsius) to Fahrenheit and returns
the result. The conversion is $F = 1.8 \times C + 32$.

## Signature

```c
double ex_0005_CelsiusToFahrenheit(double temperatureC);
```

## Examples

| **`temperatureC`** | returned value |
|--------------------|----------------|
| 0                  | 32             |
| 100                | 212            |
| -40                | -40            |
| 37.5               | 99.5           |

## Constraints

- Any real temperature is valid, including negative ones.
- Use **`double`** for the computation.
